claim_summary: For a fixed N-state trace-distance net with common residual r, the supplied commutator bound and Bansil-Kachkovskiy Corollary 1.4 yield one EB conditional-expectation channel with reconstruction error bounded by 2a + (theta/2)*sqrt(C(N))*(C0*sqrt(r/theta))^(1/3^(N-1)). No uniformity in growing N is established.
